evidence.finalAssistantMessage: Tested scope was returned as a nested bullet list; the execution-record contract requires the scalar field inline, so no implementation check was allocated.

rootCause: The producer output used nested structure for the scalar Tested scope field. The execution-record contract allows nested list structure only for Tested state and Commands; the strict parser correctly rejected the malformed runner response.
authorityDecision: Preserve scalar parser semantics and malformed-output blocking. Add the exact scalar-vs-nested field-shape rule to producer instructions; do not parse nested Tested scope as equivalent.
